name: PHP
description: Code intelligence for PHP projects using your PHP installation.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in PHP files. The language server starts when a PHP file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It runs Phpactor with PHP from your PATH.
